TEXT:
[FI] It's been a few days since the events in Atami. I've 
been invited to Ayase's place.

[FI] That's fine and all, but Ayase's behaving kind of 
strangely.

[FI] Well, maybe what happened at that inn had a 
greater effect on her than I'd thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I'm sorry. I know I called you here, and yet I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Nah, don't worry. Can't help it if you feel under the 
weather.

[FI] Honestly, she doesn't look very good. Maybe it's 
better if I come back another time.
[FI] Thinking that, I started to get up.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] P-Please wait!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hm? What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I am truly sorry about what happened!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Acting like that in front of you... I'm so ashamed of 
myself.

[FI] Actually, that felt more like a reward than anything 
else. Though I can't really say that.
[FI] ...But is that what's been on her mind all this time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I should be the one apologizing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Back then, if I'd only been able to notice that you 
were acting strangely, I could've stopped you.
[FI] I truly mean that, okay? I'm not lying.

[FI] I'd been so focused on my own thoughts that I 
didn't even think about her. That's why things went 
the way they did.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I guess I kind of lost my reasoning as well... I'm 
really sorry!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] You're not at fault, Onii-san! If I had just acted 
properly...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Besides... I'm always so serious... I don't even 
understand how I could let something like that 
happen...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm sorry. Both for this and for being so selfish on 
our usual dates.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I wish I can just lighten up and take things easy...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's all fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I mean, that's what makes you, you, Ayase.

[FI] Laughing, blushing and getting embarrassed, crying, 
being sad and getting jealous. It's all her.

[FI] She's cute either way... They're all Ayase's feelings. 
There's no need to deny any of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It's fine if you're serious. I still think that's when 
you're the cutest, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] And besides, I'm sorry too. I'm always making you 
mad...

[FI] Noticing how strange it was that we were both 
lowering our heads and reflecting on our actions, 
we laughed a little.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] We've just been apologizing over and over again 
for a while now, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...That's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So then, I guess we're even.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That's... true.

[FI] Ayase let out a sigh of relief. And then she seemed 
to notice something.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] No, it's just...

[FI] Ayase seemed to be contemplating something. ...Eh? 
What's going on here?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] D-Do guys... [font_size=33]like that kind of stuff?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]Huh?![/font_size]

[FI] W-Why are you asking that all of a sudden, 
Ayase-san?!

[FI] Not paying heed to my choking, Ayase was looking 
straight into my eyes. Her expression was the very 
image of seriousness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Look, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I love you! I want to know anything and 
everything about you! [font_size=26]However, I don't 
want anyone else seeing you in a swimsuit![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] T-That's not true. I mean, guys are basically like 
that, but I'm a gentleman.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I... see.
